title: INNER JOIN Orders with Customers
description: Join Orders and Customers tables using INNER JOIN.

data.text: Write a query to list all orders with the customer name by joining the `Orders` and `Customers` tables.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    o.OrderID,
    o.OrderDate,
    c.CustomerName,
    o.TotalAmount
FROM Orders o
INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
ORDER BY o.OrderDate DESC;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: INNER JOIN returns rows only when there is a match in both tables. Aliases (o, c) make the query cleaner. Always join on the correct foreign key relationship.
